method: For each passed trajectory, walk backward from the final feedback frame and retain the shortest final-target command window that covers the current 0.15 s settling dwell. Correct the historical stored velocity by 0.02 and verify all five speeds are within the current 8 deg/s settling-speed threshold. Add three encoder counts to each axis maximum position error and round upward to 0.1 degree.

inputs.historical_stored_velocity_issue: CAL-058 and CAL-059 JSONL were captured before CAL-016 removed the erroneous address-82 factor of 50 from Present_Velocity conversion.

evidence_selection.window_rule: shortest terminal final-command suffix spanning at least 0.15 s; corrected speed must be at most 8 deg/s on all axes
evidence_selection.loaded_overlap_policy: The later successful CAL-058 attempt3 trajectory replaces the same named attempt2 trajectory.

fit_correction.obsolete_rule: P99 position error over all motion frames plus 1 degree
fit_correction.obsolete_rule_issue: It mixes dynamic following lag into a static settling predicate.
fit_correction.regression_test: test_motion到位位置容差只使用轨迹末端连续低速窗口

limitations: The stable-window selection currently uses the CAL-068 candidate of 8 deg/s; if CAL-068 changes, CAL-067 must be replayed with the new velocity threshold.
The evidence covers the current demo trajectories, environment, and maximum 92.4 g demo payload, not the full mechanical workspace.
